arguments.name: fill
arguments.text: A value, or up to three values for the left side, the interior, and the right side. "extend" repeats an end value, or linearly interpolates the interior. NULL drops those positions.

arguments.name: ix
arguments.text: Logical positions that are already observed. Defaults to the non-missing entries.

origin.details: A length-one fill is recycled to the three positions. "extend" on a vector becomes left, interior, and right extension, so an interior gap is linearly interpolated and the ends are repeated.
origin.value: The filled series. c(1, NA, 3, NA, NA) with "extend" returns 1, 2, 3, 3, 3.
origin.example:
.libPaths(c(path.expand("~/R/library"), .libPaths()))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(zoo))
stopifnot(packageVersion("zoo") == "1.9-1")
x <- na.fill(c(1, NA, 3, NA, NA), "extend")
cat(paste(vapply(as.numeric(x), function(v) if (is.nan(v)) "NaN" else if (is.na(v)) "NA" else sprintf("%.12g", v), ""), collapse = " "), "\n", sep = "")
